explanation: Job 1 preserves all eight demand records and passes both handoffs into Job 2. Job 2 correctly classifies unsupported/direct coverage and keeps the visible priority order, but its priority records erase upstream provenance rank by setting every upstream_rank to 0. The stipulated behavior requires preserving deterministic upstream provenance order; the supplied evidence_sources provide ranks 1 through 8, so the downstream priority records should not all have upstream_rank 0.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains ranked provenance records with ranks 1 through 8 for source_ids s01 through s08.
Job 2 output priorities sets upstream_rank: 0 on every priority item, including n06-r01, n06-r07, and all supported records.
Job 2 metadata reports consumed_handoffs: ["needs", "evidence_sources"], so the ranked handoff was available to the downstream job.
